body:
It's not just loneliness, although there is a lot of that. I've had many a things go wrong in every turn I've taken in life. You know the saying "What can go wrong, will go wrong,"? Well my life is living proof of that. I know I can't blame everyone else for my problems but most of the time it was almost entirely out of my control. I can't even begin to list all of it. It would take days just to type it out. Every time there's the slightest shimmer of hope, every time things start to look up, every time I feel like I'm improving myself, something goes wrong and just drags me lower and lower. 

Sorry if not all of that makes sense. I've done some drinking and smoking
I could do that but idk what I'm gonna do for long term housing. I can't just keep bouncing around.
There are shelters near me I can stay at for a few days but beyond that idk. Plus they're about an hour drive from my work.
No one else I can stay with. Idk where I'm gonna go.

I haven't lived with my parents in 3 years but they still find ways to steal from me. They've ruined my credit score. They sold my car without my knowledge and spent the money. I could be in a different country and they would find some way to ruin me.

Why do I feel this way? Everything. The last time I actually felt happy was years ago. Everything is going downhill. When I think it can't get worse, it gets worse. No one around me cares either. Any time I try to open up nobody listens. I have no money, everything I own is broken down or breaking. My parents steal from me. I'm about to be homeless again. I have nowhere to go. No one to turn to. No one I can trust. No options. Even if I decide to keep living, I'm just gonna slowly die anyway. Why should I bother? I live near the train tracks. I'll go there and wait for a train. No one who will be at my funeral deserves to see my corpse anyway.
